findings.title: SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-28324)
findings.summary_md: SolarWinds' own advisory for CVE-2026-28324 was first published September 22, 2026, two days before the press coverage captured in the story. It describes an unauthenticated RCE from insufficient integrity checks affecting Observability Self-Hosted 2026.2.2 and below, fixed in 2026.2.3, with CVSS 3.1 score 9.8 and a network attack vector (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H). Kai Huang from Armadin is credited with the report.

findings.title: SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-28325)
findings.summary_md: The companion advisory for CVE-2026-28325 was first published September 22, 2026 and describes an unauthenticated RCE from deserialization of untrusted data when the application is configured to use a specific communication mode. It affects Observability Self-Hosted 2026.2.2 and below, is fixed in 2026.2.3, and carries CVSS 3.1 8.8 with an adjacent attack vector (AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H). Kai Huang from Armadin is credited.

findings.title: SolarWinds Access Rights Manager Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-28326)
findings.summary_md: SolarWinds published the ARM advisory on September 17, 2026, five days before the Observability Self-Hosted advisories. It attributes an unauthenticated RCE to a hardcoded static key affecting Access Rights Manager 2026.2 and all previous versions, fixed in ARM 2026.2.1, with CVSS 3.1 8.8 and an adjacent attack vector (AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H). Kai Huang from Armadin is again credited.

findings.title: NVD entry for CVE-2026-28324
findings.summary_md: The NVD record for CVE-2026-28324 was published 2026-09-22T20:17:03Z per the NVD API 2.0. It preserves the vendor description of an unauthenticated RCE due to insufficient integrity checks in non-default, non-secure configurations and independently confirms the disclosure date of the advisory.

findings.title: NVD entry for CVE-2026-28325
findings.summary_md: The NVD record for CVE-2026-28325 was published 2026-09-22T20:17:03Z, the same publication batch as CVE-2026-28324. The description matches the vendor advisory: unauthenticated RCE from deserialization of untrusted data in a specific communication mode.

findings.title: NVD entry for CVE-2026-28326
findings.summary_md: The NVD record for CVE-2026-28326 was published 2026-09-17T17:16:39Z, confirming the ARM advisory date of September 17, 2026. The record describes the unauthenticated RCE stemming from a hardcoded static key.
